For a sweep-shaped command, HEAD's run counts as green when every file the sweep graded red (read through _runner_output.sweep_failures, LF or CRLF) is a stubbed-new declared test file graded 'no --selftest' and nothing else. baseline_problem takes `stubbed`, and both callers pass it: red_verdict, and the gate before the fix run. A file present at HEAD that prints no contract is never in `stubbed`, so it stays not green. A quiet one-file sweep reads its summary as that file's row. A quiet multi-file sweep with no row says it could not read one rather than falling back to the total. The totals are compared only when no red file printed a tally.
